agent_explanation: Total mechanical energy increases despite no controller work and dissipative restitution (e=0.6,0.9). Shrunk scenario uses large dt=0.0265 with gravity=14.45 and high initial speeds. Semi-implicit Euler with substeps still exhibits significant numerical energy drift: body0 falling gains more kinetic energy than it loses in potential each step (PE->KE conversion not conservative at this dt), causing system energy to rise from 3985.8J to 4217.7J to 4565.2J, exceeding the 10%+5J bound (limit 4389.4J) by step2. Reducing dt to 0.001 with identical initial conditions eliminates the drift, confirming time-integration error as cause rather than restitution or controller work.
